title: Introducing GPT-5
summary: We are introducing GPT‑5, our best AI system yet. GPT‑5 is a significant leap in intelligence over all our previous models, featuring state-of-the-art performance across coding, math, writing, health, visual perception, and more.
body: We are introducing GPT‑5, our best AI system yet. GPT‑5 is a significant leap in intelligence over all our previous models, featuring state-of-the-art performance across coding, math, writing, health, visual perception, and more.
summaryZh: OpenAI重磅推出了新一代旗舰AI系统GPT-5，标志着模型智能水平取得了跨越式发展。该模型在编程、数学、写作、医疗健康以及视觉感知等多个关键领域展现出行业领先的顶尖性能，为大语言模型技术设定了全新的能力基准。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI正式发布新一代旗舰模型GPT-5，在多个领域实现显著的智能跃升。
